verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-retention settings, retention periods, execution-log or history purging, or account or data deletion controls. It shows only adjacent resource management: deleting scenarios, deleting AI Agents through a beta API, and modifying data stores through MCP. None of these is a documented privacy control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
